description:
A stable guard needs no comparison, a co-stable one over groups compares
  the group versions, anything over Issued compares the registry version.

steps.name: the policy "exists x in S. Revoked(x)" is classified
its class is "stable" and its CAS mode is "none"
the policy "atleast 2 x in S. Revoked(x)" is classified
its class is "stable" and its CAS mode is "none"
the policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is classified
its class is "co-stable" and its CAS mode is "group"
the policy "atmost 1 x in S. Revoked(x)" is classified
its class is "co-stable" and its CAS mode is "group"
the policy "forall x in Issued. NotRevoked(x)" is classified
its class is "co-stable" and its CAS mode is "global"
the policy "exists x in Issued. NotRevoked(x)" is classified
its class is "volatile" and its CAS mode is "global"

name: The class of a guard decides the CAS mode

description:
The landlord books the flat by revoking the winner's interest credential,
  but only while no member of the interested group S has been revoked.

elements.name: Without a bound policy the flat is booked twice

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
the guard policy is not bound to Revoke
Alice and Bob both prove the guard against group version 0
the landlord revokes Alice's credential
the landlord revokes Bob's credential
both revocations are accepted
the version of S is 2

elements.name: With a bound policy the second booking is rejected

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
the guard policy is bound to Revoke for the CredDef
Alice and Bob both prove the guard against group version 0
the landlord revokes Alice's credential with her guard
the revocation is accepted
the version of S is 1
the landlord revokes Bob's credential with his guard
the revocation is rejected with "StaleGroupVersion"
Bob's credential is not revoked

elements.name: A stale guard proof is valid but not fresh

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
Alice's guarded revocation has been accepted
a verifier checks Bob's guard proof
the proof is cryptographically valid
it is not fresh because S moved from version 0 to 1

elements.name: A bound policy cannot be bypassed

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
the guard policy is bound to Revoke for the CredDef
the landlord revokes Carol's credential without a guard
the revocation is rejected with "PolicyRequired"
Carol's credential is not revoked

elements.name: The loser's proof stays valid after later updates

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
Alice's guarded revocation has been accepted
Bob proves "exists x in S. Revoked(x)"
the proof is valid and its class is "stable"
the landlord issues a new credential to Dave
Bob's proof is still valid and fresh

elements.name: Alice proves the reservation without revealing who she is

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
Alice's guarded revocation has been accepted
Alice proves 'exists x in S. Sig(x, "Landlord") & Revoked(x)'
the verifier accepts the proof
the proof does not reveal which member of S she is

name: Flat reservation with atomic guarded revocation

description:
The registry contract checks every write against the current state,
  so a wrong value never reaches the ledger.

elements.name: A CredDef needs an existing schema

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
the landlord registers a CredDef for an unknown schema
the registration is rejected with "UnknownSchema"

elements.name: The chain rejects a wrong revocation step

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice and Bob
the landlord submits a revocation of Alice with a wrong new A
the revocation is rejected with "StepCheckFailed"
Alice's credential is not revoked

elements.name: A group witness must match the set

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document

a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
